login.title: Channel Partner Login
login.welcome: Masantos ya kabwasan! Man-sign in pian naasikaso iray lead mo.
login.heroTitle: Pabalegen so negosyom ed real-estate diad kada lead ya itarok mo
login.heroIntro: Sakey a portal ya pangirehistro na saray kustomer ed saray managpaalagey, pansiansiaen so kredito parad saray lead mo tan tumboken ira anggad panag-book.

register.title: Iparehistro iray lead ed loob na pigaran segundo
register.text: Isumite so kustomer mo tan say proyekton labay da.

protect.title: Proteksion ed duplikado
protect.text: Say lead mo et mansiansian kayarian mo legan na panaon na proteksion, kanian anggapo lay arum ya makapangibaga na parehon kustomer.

track.title: Subaybayan so kada yugtan
track.text: Nengnengen so kipapasen tan interon history na kada lead, manlapud inmunan impitongtong anggad impan-book.

handover.title: Credit nen nan-book
handover.text: No man-book so sakey a kustomer, say lead et iter ed managpaalagey ya sika so nirekord bilang source partner.

login.secure: Maligen ya pan-sign-in - saray detalye na saray kustomer yo et mansiansian pribado

signup.title: Panrehistro na Channel Partner
signup.intro: Manggawa na account mo pian makapangigapo kan manparehistro tan mangasikaso ed saray sarilim ya lead.
